info.title: Jatri API
info.description: Flight, bus and train ticket booking for Bangladesh. All responses use the `{success, data, error}` envelope.

delete.description:
In-app account deletion (Google Play requirement). Personal data is removed; bookings that
must be kept for accounting will be anonymised here once they exist (Phase 3+).

post.description: Results are cached for a few minutes; live price and seats are re-checked at booking time.

Holds the seats for `hold_minutes` (status `held`). Send an `Idempotency-Key` header so a
retried request returns the same booking instead of holding seats twice.
Phase 3: releases an unpaid hold. Paid bookings get cancellation + refund in Phase 7.
Starts a payment for a held booking and returns the gateway page to open in a browser tab.
Server-to-server notification from the gateway (IPN). This, not the app, decides if a payment succeeded.

expected_total.title: Expected Total
expected_total.description: Total (paisa) the app showed; a different live price returns price_changed
